summary.text: Leonora Dodge is a Democrat from Essex who has represented Chittenden-23 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2023.
She sits on the House Committee on General and Housing.

paragraphs.text: Dodge was born to Irish and Mexican parents and grew up in Montreal and Mexico City, according to her House biography.

She earned a B.A. in Latin American Studies from Williams College and an M.A. in Latin American History from the University of Texas at Austin, and she received a Mellon Fellowship, a Ford grant and a Fulbright.
Since moving to Vermont in 2000 she has volunteered with organizations including HomeShare Vermont, Justicia Migrante/Migrant Justice and Essex B.E.S.T.
Before running for office she taught Spanish at Vermont Commons High School and Champlain College and worked as a classroom paraeducator in the Spanish Immersion Elementary program in Jericho.
She lives in Essex with her husband and two children and is fluent in French and Spanish.
